rows.title: Okay
rows.text:
These are okay, you get $45 for Fandango, which I bought as a Deal of the Day so it was a little less expensive, but as far as ease of use they are not good.

There's no way to pre-load these gift cards to your account, so we had to make sure the gift cards were always with us. We usually buy our tickets on Fandango through our phone while sitting at dinner, or on the way to the theater, but if we had left the cards at home...too bad.

There's no way to scan the cards with your phone either. That means having to type in each card number (19 digits) then scratching to reveal the pin number to type in another 4. It's a pain when purchasing multiple tickets that cost more than a single $15 dollar card so you're there typing, scratching, typing, typing, scratching, typing from several cards like a weirdo.

rows.title: Avoid and Do Not Use
rows.text: It's been a while since I have bought these. I decided to pull one out and use it for a Christmas present this year to avoid a trip to a store for one card. Big mistake. Claim code couldn't be used by the recipient and customer service told her the one who purchased it had to be the one to call in about it. Customer service couldn't make it work. I was told the serial number should only be 16 digits. Not only does the serial number on the card match the serial number that appears in the "My Orders" section, but the description page for the Flex card also says the serial number is 19 digits. While customer service was able to make it right, by canceling the order so I could resent (by e-gift method this time), this was a hassle that should have been able to be avoided. I get the impression that either 1) these were phased out (going by the "Currently Unavailable" message) and no one bothered to block the cards that were still floating around from being loaded or 2) the Flex cards (being different from cards bought in a store) have a different method to be load to accounts and no one bothered to differentiate it anywhere on the site making it impossible to load them to accounts. I like the concept behind them and I have used them before; but at this point, I will toss any I still have and recommend others do as well.

rows.title: Gift Card - shipping problem
rows.text:
Ordered a $150 boxed gift card on 2-13 with 1 click ordering. The gift card page and the individual item page all say "free one day shipping" everywhere. On 2-15 receive an email that the card has shipped, with a tracking number, by USPS, with estimated delivery of 2-21, from MARYLAND. I'm in Seattle - the home of Amazon - and they ship by regular snail mail from MARYLAND??? Of course, since it has shipped, there is nothing I can do to change it and I'll miss the birthday on the 18th it was purchased for.

BUYERS BEWARE you don't get caught by the same thing. One day free shipping apparently doesn't work with 1 click ordering. I'll never order another gift card from Amazon.
